children: K&F Growth Acquisition II entered into non-redemption agreements with investors who agree not to redeem their public shares in connection with the extension vote. If the business combination closes by May 6, 2027, investors may receive one share of the surviving company for every six shares they keep; if it closes later, they may receive one additional share for every 30 shares kept. The arrangement is intended to increase the funds remaining in the company's trust account after the meeting.
